authorityNote: This vocabulary is a derived conformance research aid. It does not own capability, state, authority, effects, or domain truth.

laws.projection: derived projection must preserve owner/truth-role/applicability and must not duplicate mutable authority
laws.currentness: unproven currentness must be explicit rather than inferred
laws.mechanicalResolution: mechanically forced details should be resolved by infrastructure where owner-native proof exists
laws.semanticSovereignty: semantic relevance, strategy, completion, and domain decisions remain Agent/domain responsibility
laws.failure: mechanically knowable effect/retry/reconcile state should be projected; unknown state must remain unknown
laws.escapeHatch: high-level happy paths must retain access to exact native primitives/evidence

counterexamples.Web: useful derived agent context with stale upstream source revisions
counterexamples.RuntimeConnector: live owner catalog has runtime.describe while one published consumer catalog omits it
